Food processors live on quality, yield and traceability: intake grading, process yield, food-safety evidence and provenance claims. Vision grading, yield analytics and chain-of-custody convert commodity margin into brand margin.

Governance inherits the sector frame — Food safety (HACCP/EU 178/FSMA) among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

At Agriculture & Food Systems level this capability reads as: soil, weather and crop sensing with governance (variable-rate practice enabled). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
